1.web: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
1.asv: O God, keep not thou silence: Hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

2.web: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
2.asv: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult; And they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

3.web: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
3.asv: They take crafty counsel against thy people, And consult together against thy hidden ones.

4.web: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
4.asv: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

5.web: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
5.asv: For they have consulted together with one consent; Against thee do they make a covenant:

6.web: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
6.asv: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagarenes;

7.web: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
7.asv: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre:

8.web: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
8.asv: Assyria also is joined with them; They have helped the children of Lot. [Selah

9.web: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
9.asv: Do thou unto them as unto Midian, As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

10.web: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
10.asv: Who perished at Endor, Who became as dung for the earth.

11.web: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;
11.asv: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; Yea, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;

12.web: who said, “Let us take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
12.asv: Who said, Let us take to ourselves in possession The habitations of God.

13.web: My God, make them like tumbleweed; like chaff before the wind.
13.asv: O my God, make them like the whirling dust; As stubble before the wind.

14.web: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,
14.asv: As the fire that burneth the forest, And as the flame that setteth the mountains on fire,

15.web: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
15.asv: So pursue them with thy tempest, And terrify them with thy storm.

16.web: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.
16.asv: Fill their faces with confusion, That they may seek thy name, O Jehovah.

17.web: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
17.asv: Let them be put to shame and dismayed for ever; Yea, let them be confounded and perish;

18.web: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
18.asv: That they may know that thou alone, whose name is Jehovah, Art the Most High over all the earth.
